statements.status_notes: moment 2.31.0 fixes CVE-2026-17495, but the searchRelevanceDashboards plugin ships an isolated node_modules copy at 2.30.1. Resolutions and lockfile rewrites on that plugin do not replace the copy bundled into the plugin artifact.
